requirements.description_en:
By derogation from paragraph 2, an AI system referred to in Annex III shall not be considered to be high-risk where it does not pose a significant risk of harm to the health, safety or fundamental rights of natural persons, including by not materially influencing the outcome of decision making.

The first subparagraph shall apply where any of the following conditions is fulfilled:

requirements.description_en: A provider who considers that an AI system referred to in Annex III is not high-risk shall document its assessment before that system is placed on the market or put into service. Such provider shall be subject to the registration obligation set out in Article 49(2). Upon request of national competent authorities, the provider shall provide the documentation of the assessment.

requirements.description_en: The oversight measures shall be commensurate with the risks, level of autonomy and context of use of the high-risk AI system, and shall be ensured through either one or both of the following types of measures:

sub_items.description_ja: 提供者が特定した対策を、上梓前に高リスクAIシステムに組み込んだ対策
sub_items.description_en: measures identified and built, when technically feasible, into the high-risk AI system by the provider before it is placed on the market or put into service;

sub_items.description_ja: 提供者が特定した対策で、利用者が実施
sub_items.description_en: measures identified by the provider before placing the high-risk AI system on the market or putting it into service and that are appropriate to be implemented by the deployer.

requirements.description_ja: 監視に関してユーザーに提供される情報
requirements.description_en: the high-risk AI system shall be provided to the deployer in such a way that natural persons to whom human oversight is assigned are enabled, as appropriate and proportionate:

sub_items.description_ja: 異常、機能不全、予期せぬ動作の検出と対処できるように、提供される
sub_items.description_en: to properly understand the relevant capacities and limitations of the high-risk AI system and be able to duly monitor its operation, including in view of detecting and addressing anomalies, dysfunctions and unexpected performance;

sub_items.description_ja: 自動化バイアスに注意を払うように、提供されること
sub_items.description_en: to remain aware of the possible tendency of automatically relying or over-relying on the output produced by a high-risk AI system (automation bias), in particular for high-risk AI systems used to provide information or recommendations for decisions to be taken by natural persons;

sub_items.description_ja: 高リスクAIシステムの出力を解釈できるように、提供されること
sub_items.description_en: to correctly interpret the high-risk AI system’s output, taking into account, for example, the interpretation tools and methods available;

sub_items.description_ja: 出力を反転したりオーバライドしたり、利用を停止することができるように、提供されること
sub_items.description_en: to decide, in any particular situation, not to use the high-risk AI system or to otherwise disregard, override or reverse the output of the high-risk AI system

sub_items.description_ja: ストップボタンを押すあるいは安全な状態で停止することができるように、提供されていること
sub_items.description_en: to intervene in the operation of the high-risk AI system or interrupt the system through a ‘stop’ button or a similar procedure that allows the system to come to a halt in a safe state.

article_text.ja: 高リスクAIシステムは、適切なレベルの精度、堅牢性、安全性、サイバーセキュリティを達成するように設計・開発されなければならない
article_text.en: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed to achieve appropriate levels of accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity

requirements.description_ja: 適切なレベルの精度、堅牢性、安全性、サイバーセキュリティの達成
requirements.description_en: Achieve appropriate levels of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity
requirements.conditions: 高リスクAIシステム
requirements.verification_method: 性能テスト、セキュリティ評価

requirements.description_ja: 精度、堅牢性の計測方法について委員会は関連する機関と協力しベンチマークや計測手法を開発する
requirements.description_en: To address the technical aspects of how to measure the appropriate levels of accuracy and robustness set out in paragraph 1 and any other relevant performance metrics

requirements.description_ja: 正確性のレベルと指標を取説に記述
requirements.description_en: Document accuracy levels and metrics in instructions

requirements.description_ja: 人や他のシステムとの相互作用で生じるエラー等に対する、レジリエンスや頑健性や対策の実施
requirements.description_en: High-risk AI systems shall be as resilient as possible regarding errors, faults or inconsistencies that may occur within the system or the environment in which the system operates, in particular due to their interaction with natural persons or other systems. Technical and organisational measures shall be taken in this regard.

sub_items.description_ja: バックアップやfail-safe機能などの多重化による頑健性を持つか
sub_items.description_en: The robustness of high-risk AI systems may be achieved through technical redundancy solutions, which may include backup or fail-safe plans.

sub_items.description_ja: 上梓後も学習をするシステムは、feedback loopを起こさないように対策されているか？
sub_items.description_en: High-risk AI systems that continue to learn after being placed on the market or put into service shall be developed in such a way as to eliminate or reduce as far as possible the risk of possibly biased outputs influencing input for future operations (feedback loops), and as to ensure that any such feedback loops are duly addressed with appropriate mitigation measures.

requirements.description_ja: 第三者の攻撃に対する、レジリエンスや頑健性や対策の実施
requirements.description_en: shall be resilient against attempts by unauthorised third parties to alter their use, outputs or performance by exploiting system vulnerabilities.

sub_items.description_ja: サイバーセキュリティを確保するための技術的な解決方法
sub_items.description_en: The technical solutions aiming to ensure the cybersecurity of high-risk AI systems shall be appropriate to the relevant circumstances and the risks.

sub_items.description_ja: data汚染や、モデル汚染、敵対的example攻撃、秘密情報への攻撃など、害のある意思決定につながるような、攻撃に対する検知、反応、解決に対する技術的な解決方法
sub_items.description_en: The technical solutions to address AI specific vulnerabilities shall include, where appropriate, measures to prevent, detect, respond to, resolve and control for attacks trying to manipulate the training data set (data poisoning), or pre-trained components used in training (model poisoning), inputs designed to cause the AI model to make a mistake (adversarial examples or model evasion), confidentiality attacks or model flaws.

requirements.description_ja: 48条にあるようなCE-marking
requirements.description_en: affix the CE marking to the high-risk AI system or, where that is not possible, on its packaging or its accompanying documentation, to indicate conformity with this Regulation, in accordance with Article 48;

requirements.description_ja: 49条(1)にあるような登録義務
requirements.description_en: comply with the registration obligations referred to in Article 49(1);

requirements.description_ja: 20条にあるような修正のアクションと情報の提供

requirements.description_en: upon a reasoned request of a national competent authority, demonstrate the conformity of the high-risk AI system with the requirements set out in Section 2;

requirements.description_ja: アクセシビリティ要求への適合
requirements.description_en: ensure that the high-risk AI system complies with accessibility requirements in accordance with Directives (EU) 2016/2102 and (EU) 2019/882.

sub_items.description_en: systems and procedures for record-keeping of all relevant documentation and information;

sub_items.description_en: an accountability framework setting out the responsibilities of the management and other staff with regard to all the aspects listed in this paragraph.

article_text.en: Deployers of high-risk AI systems shall take appropriate technical and organisational measures in accordance with instructions for use

requirements.description_ja: 使用説明書に従った技術的および組織的措置
requirements.description_en: Technical and organisational measures per instructions
requirements.conditions: 高リスクAIシステムの配置者

requirements.description_ja: 自然人による監視の割り当て
requirements.description_en: Assign natural persons for oversight

requirements.description_ja: 入力データの関連性と代表性の確認
requirements.description_en: Ensure input data is relevant and representative

requirements.description_ja: 運用の監視と提供者への通知
requirements.description_en: Monitor operation and inform provider

requirements.description_ja: ログを少なくとも６か月保持
requirements.description_en: Retain logs for at least 6 months

requirements.description_ja: 職場利用時の、労働者への通知
requirements.description_en: Before putting into service or using a high-risk AI system at the workplace, deployers who are employers shall inform workers’ representatives and the affected workers that they will be subject to the use of the high-risk AI system

requirements.description_ja: 公共機関に準じる場合は、４９条の登録義務の遵守
requirements.description_en: Deployers of high-risk AI systems that are public authorities, or Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies shall comply with the registration obligations referred to in Article 49

requirements.description_ja: １３条に基づき提供された情報からデータ保護影響評価を実施
requirements.description_en: Where applicable, deployers of high-risk AI systems shall use the information provided under Article 13 of this Regulation to comply with their obligation to carry out a data protection impact assessment

requirements.description_ja: 犯罪捜査の場合は、司法・行政当局の許可を得る
requirements.description_en: in the framework of an investigation for the targeted search of a person suspected or convicted of having committed a criminal offence, the deployer of a high-risk AI system for post-remote biometric identification shall request an authorisation, ex ante, or without undue delay and no later than 48 hours, by a judicial authority or an administrative authority whose decision is binding and subject to judicial review, for the use of that system, except when it is used for the initial identification of a potential suspect based on objective and verifiable facts directly linked to the offence. Each use shall be limited to what is strictly necessary for the investigation of a specific criminal offence.

requirements.description_ja: 高リスクＡＩシステムの配置者は、自然人に対するAIシステム使用の通知
requirements.description_en: deployers of high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III that make decisions or assist in making decisions related to natural persons shall inform the natural persons that they are subject to the use of the high-risk AI system.

requirements.description_ja: 権限当局との協力
requirements.description_en: Deployers shall cooperate with the relevant competent authorities in any action those authorities take in relation to the high-risk AI system in order to implement this Regulation.

article_text.ja: 高リスクAIシステムの提供者は、市場投入前または使用開始前に適合性評価を実施しなければならない
article_text.en: Providers shall ensure that high-risk AI systems undergo conformity assessment before being placed on the market or put into service

requirements.description_en: The information referred to in paragraphs 1 to 4 shall be provided to the natural persons concerned in a clear and distinguishable manner at the latest at the time of the first interaction or exposure. The information shall conform to the applicable accessibility requirements.

requirements.description_en: Paragraphs 1 to 4 shall not affect the requirements and obligations set out in Chapter III, and shall be without prejudice to other transparency obligations laid down in Union or national law for deployers of AI systems.

requirements.description_en: A general-purpose AI model shall be presumed to have high impact capabilities pursuant to paragraph 1, point (a), when the cumulative amount of computation used for its training measured in floating point operations is greater than 10^25.

requirements.description_ja: 97条に基づき委員会は、 51条(1)および51条(2)に示す閾値を修正するためには、移譲法を採用しなければならない
requirements.description_en: The Commission shall adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 97 to amend the thresholds listed in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article, as well as to supplement benchmarks and indicators in light of evolving technological developments, such as algorithmic improvements or increased hardware efficiency, when necessary, for these thresholds to reflect the state of the art.
